messages:
priya: Customer reports OAuth login failing intermittently in production for both GitHub and Google. They see `invalid_state` after redirect from provider. Happens from our webapp behind Akamai, but not when they hit the app directly in a dev environment. Repro steps attached below.

dan: Can you paste the full redirect URL from the provider callback (with state param)? obvs redact tokens but keep state+code.

priya: Here is the callback line from their logs: 
`GET /auth/callback?code=4/abc123&state=QmFzZTY0K3VybHNlY2M9LVN0YXRlK3BhZGRpbmc=`
They also sent what we receive at our endpoint: `state=QmFzZTY0%2Burxlec%3D%3D` but then our app logs show we computed `state` as `QmFzZTY0+urlsecc=-State+padding` (truncated).

leo: That looks like a mix of base64 urlsafe vs percent-encoding transformations. Could the CDN be unescaping `%2B` to `+` and then stripping padding `=`? Also our state is 48 bytes and I know some proxies trim long query params.

emily: Customer says the issue happens only when users sign in via the corporate SSO which terminates TLS at the CDN. When they switch to direct origin (bypass CDN) the auth flow succeeds.

dan: Ok let's try to reproduce locally by proxying through a simple nginx with `proxy_pass` and `proxy_set_header` to simulate. If nginx/akamai is converting `+` to space or dropping `%3D` padding, we'll see it. Quick test: I set up an nginx rule and forwarded `state=AB+C%3D%3D` — the origin received `AB C==`.

priya: Customer provided the failing user agent: `Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 12) WebView` — this is an embedded webview in their mobile app. When they open same flow in Chrome on Android it works.

leo: WebViews often decode `+` differently when used in a querystring vs form body. Combined with a proxy double-unescape step, you can end up with space or dropped padding. Unique combo.

emily: Workaround idea: normalize state on our side before strict compare — accept base64 with missing padding and both `+` and `%2B` variants. Also consider signing a shorter hex state (urlsafe) to avoid `+`/`=` chars.

dan: Agreed. Short-term patch: in `server/auth/verify_state` allow `state_alt = state.replace(' ', '+')` and try `atob` with and without `=` padding. If any decodes match the stored nonce, accept. I'll open a hotfix PR.

priya: Customer asked for root cause so they can fix their mobile wrapper. We should capture: (1) CDN or proxy double-decoding of querystring, (2) Android WebView conversion of `+` to space, (3) base64 padding being stripped by intermediate. All three together cause mismatch.

support-bot: Deploy scheduled: patch-auth-state-normalization -> staging at 2026-03-18T02:15:00Z, prod rollout in 30m after smoke.

emily: Docs note: recommend using urlsafe base64 (RFC 4648, "-" and "_") or hex for state to avoid `+` and `=` entirely. I'll add a short KB for customers integrating mobile webviews.

priya: Customer verified the hotfix on staging and reported sign-ins succeeding via their CDN path. Will monitor for 24h then confirm closure. :thumbsup:
